transport: RS-485 on pins 5 (Data −) and 6 (Data +) of the Evolution 2.0 aux Molex, described by genmon's wiring page only as 'Used for built in WiFi support'. Baud, framing, slave ID and protocol are ALL UNKNOWN — no source states any of them, and none are guessed here.
